Vendored so bootstrap does not fetch GitHub.

- `voxprint_common-0.3.1-py3-none-any.whl`: the official v0.3.1 release asset from https://github.com/Mitroshenkov87/voxprint-common/releases/download/v0.3.1/voxprint_common-0.3.1-py3-none-any.whl (tag commit faa9a1239db864c4f759927838aece38b38866e8; sha256 `f14036fc70db07e40e5e5376427cea28c3173a94f1d031997a3259ed0afc91fd`, also in the `.sha256` sidecar). It bundles the serial 9 signed model index (index head 15edeab, sha256 104742f9…f49e45f), the voxprint-model/1 schema with `onnx_prebuilt` and `post_install` (schema sha256 08dc67f3…ec08), and our index public key (`keys/index-public.pem`). CI, docs, release builds and the Windows setup install it. The `gui` extra pins `voxprint-common[ui]==0.3.1`.
